english.title: Make entry in rent book etc to show / purport to show tenant in arrears on account of irrecoverable rent
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 57(4) of the Rent Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
made an entry in
rent book / similar document
showing / purporting to show
tenant as being in arrears
in respect of a sum on account of rent
which was irrecoverable by virtue of
Pt III of the Rent Act 1977

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: It shall be a defence to prove that, at the time of the making of the entry, the landlord had a bona fide claim that the sum was recoverable.
